Scope: Full plus PSLGP-I (displayed as PSLGP), NSGPII and MOGP/D; ablations retain their original three-method references
Selection: Full: fixed final first-ranked task heuristic; PSLGP-I: final snapshot ind=0, all200 preferences; NSGPII/MOGP-D: final archived solution set
SnapshotNumbers: 49 for Full, 24 for archived PSLGP, 29 for archived NSGPII/MOEAD; archived CSV indices are snapshots, not asserted actual training generations
Normalization: Per-scenario objective min/max pooled over the four displayed methods, including all Full groups and seeds
ReferenceFront: Unique nondominated union of the four methods' normalized valid outcomes
IGD: Arithmetic mean nearest-outcome distance from joint reference to all valid outcomes
InvalidPolicy: Conditional valid-only. All seeds retained. Two archived PSLGP-I preferences invalid; no all-invalid run
Dispersion: Sample standard deviation over30 evolutionary runs per method/scenario or Full group/task
Display: Means and sample standard deviations shown to three decimal places; calculations and best-mean selection use unrounded values
Inference: Descriptive common-reference quality, not a matched-budget or runtime-verified causal comparison. No cross-archive paired significance marks
Budget: Full configured50 generations/1000 shared individuals; independent archive configs51generations/1000 individuals per task
ArchiveRuntime: Historical archive lacks per-run runtime-v2 provenance; current checks cannot retroactively certify it
